body.purpose: Default Fira Sans UI text, descriptions, nav labels.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ghost/outline crimson CTA — the primary action, restrained until hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; padding: 10px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #e0483a; border-radius: 10px; color: #e0483a; font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e0483a; color: #070a12; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(224,72,58,0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation button with a fixed 28px icon slot; default gray → hover crimson → active on blue-tint.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; background: rgba(14,18,28,0.85); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); border-radius: 10px; color: #dce0e6; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(90,110,150,0.14); border-color: #e0483a; color: #e0483a; } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { background: rgba(74,140,220,0.13); border-color: #e0483a; color: #e0483a; } .ds-nav-icon { min-width: 28px; height: 28px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-nav-icon svg { fill: currentColor; } .ds-nav-label { flex: 1; text-align: left; }

components.name: KPI Stat Card
components.description: Signature data tile — muted uppercase label over a bright monospace value, with the diagonal hatch overlay.
components.html:
TOTAL NET WORTH
4,182,640,915 ISK
+2.4% · 24H
components.css: .ds-kpi { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(10,13,20,0.85); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; } .ds-kpi::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.010) 0px, rgba(255,255,255,0.010) 0.5px, transparent 0.5px, transparent 4px); pointer-events: none; } .ds-kpi > * { position: relative; z-index: 2; } .ds-kpi-label { font-family: 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #909090; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-kpi-value { font-family: 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #e0564b; } .ds-kpi-unit { font-size: 11px; color: #7e858f; font-weight: 400; } .ds-kpi-sub { font-family: 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 10px; color: #4ada8a; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Deep translucent mono field with a quiet crimson focus glow — no outline.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Type or ISK amount" value="Tritanium">
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: rgba(10,13,20,0.85); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); border-radius: 8px; color: #c6cbd3; font-family: 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 13px; padding: 6px 10px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #565b63; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(224,72,58,0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(224,72,58,0.08); }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: 42×24 pill switch — deep fill + gray knob off, solid crimson + white knob on.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 42px; height: 24px; } .ds-switch input { opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; } .ds-switch-slider { position: absolute; inset: 0; cursor: pointer; background: rgba(14,18,28,0.85); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); border-radius: 24px; transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-switch-slider::before { content: ''; position: absolute; height: 16px; width: 16px; left: 3px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); background: #dce0e6; border-radius: 50%; transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-slider { background: #e0483a; border-color: #e0483a; } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-slider::before { transform: translate(18px, -50%); background: #fff; }

components.name: Count Badge
components.description: Pill badge — crimson-dim fill, crimson mono text; the one accent chip in a panel header.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; background: #7d201a; color: #e0483a; font-family: 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 10px; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: Structural page panel (the default surface) — translucent tint, backdrop blur, specular rim, panel-lift shadow, tracked header with count badge.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: rgba(12,16,24,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(145%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(145%); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); border-radius: 14px; padding: 10px 12px; box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.35), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.14); color: #ccd1da; } .ds-panel-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: #7e858f; padding-bottom: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-panel-count { margin-left: auto; background: #7d201a; color: #e0483a; font-size: 10px; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-panel-body { font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #b4bac4; }

narrative.overview:
EVE Carbon is a dense, utility-forward data overlay whose primary material is translucent fluted glass floating over the operating system — the resting default, not a toggle. It merges the physical, refractive identity of reeded glass with an all-business tactical layout: subdued blue-nebula glows bleed through from behind, contrasting with crisp edges, hatch textures, and scanline-thin scrollbars on the surface. The chrome is deliberately near-invisible so that the information-heavy data and the textured glass remain the sole focus.

The system lives in a permanent tension between two registers. The backdrop is cinematic: cool deep-space black, twin ambient blue glows that pulse slowly, a whisper-fine diagonal hatch, and acrylic glass refracting the desktop. The foreground is instrument-grade: monospace figures, uppercase micro-labels on tight tracking, right-aligned numeric columns, crisp white-alpha hairlines. Atmosphere sets the mood; precision carries the meaning. Neither is allowed to win.

This is EVE Carbon's own identity, not a reskin of the in-game client. A single built-in theme ships — Default (Nebula Glass): cool deep-space surfaces, a refined crimson signal over blue nebula. There are no other named presets; users recolour by editing the 16-swatch palette, and every colour routes through tokens so a custom palette repaints the whole terminal at once.
keyCharacteristics: Translucent reeded/acrylic glass as the defining material and the resting default, over a cool deep-space backdrop.
Instrument-grade data foreground: monospace values, uppercase tracked labels, crisp white-alpha hairline structure.
Sharp 2px geometry that rounds into glass as the default surface treatment; a clear focus/blur depth hierarchy for overlays.
A single restrained crimson signal riding on top of an eight-hue data palette that carries all quantitative meaning.
Total themeability by derivation — a ~120-token map computed from just 16 user swatches, with the accent bound by role, not hardcoded (one Default theme + user palettes).

rules.name: The Accent-Is-A-Role Rule
rules.body: Never hardcode the highlight color. The accent is roles.accent resolved against the active 16-swatch palette and expressed only through the --accent* tokens. A literal crimson hex breaks every user palette instantly.

rules.name: The Derive-Don't-Author Rule
rules.body: Any new accent tint, hue variant, or state color is generated from a swatch via the theme-vars.js helpers (hexToRgba / lighten / darken), not typed as a fresh literal. Sixteen swatches are the only hand-set colors; the rest is math so themes stay coherent.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: The accent — whatever hue the active theme binds it to — is a guideline of restraint, not a hard cap: it should mark the single most important state or action in view. When two things both want the accent, one of them is wrong — promote it with the data palette or hierarchy instead.

rules.name: The Token-Or-Nothing Rule
rules.body: No chart, KPI, badge, or status may hardcode one of the eight data hues. Reference --pal-* / --chart-* so a user palette repaints the whole app. A raw hex in a component is a bug.

rules.name: The Color-Is-Not-The-Only-Signal Rule
rules.body: In dense data views, color reinforces meaning but never carries it alone — pair every hue with a label, icon, sign, or position.

rules.name: The Numbers-Are-Mono Rule
rules.body: Every quantity — ISK, LP, quantities, percentages, IDs, timers — is set in Fira Code. Language is Fira Sans. This split is how the eye finds the data.

rules.name: The Muted-Label / Bright-Value Rule
rules.body: Labels are muted and tracked (--label-muted); the value they describe is bright (--value-bright). Never invert this, and never inline-style either — always class + token.

rules.name: The Focus-Stack Rule
rules.body: Depth encodes focus. The active surface is sharp and lifted; whatever it sits on top of is blurred and dimmed. When an overlay opens, blur and scrim the layer behind it — never leave two planes competing at the same clarity.

rules.name: The Ambient-Glow-Never-Interacts Rule
rules.body: The nebula glows are backdrop only: z-index:0, pointer-events:none, mix-blend-mode:screen. They set mood behind the frame and never touch, tint, or obscure data.

dos: Do route every chart, KPI, badge, and status color through the --pal-* / --chart-* tokens so a user palette repaints the whole app.
Do treat the accent as a role over a 16-swatch palette — bind it via roles.accent and consume it only through --accent*, so the Default theme and every user palette resolve correctly.
Do set every quantity in Fira Code and every piece of language in Fira Sans.
Do keep labels muted and tracked (--label-muted) with the value they describe bright (--value-bright) — via class + token, never inline style.
Do encode focus with depth: the active surface is sharp and lifted; blur and dim whatever it sits on top of. When an overlay opens, blur and scrim the layer behind it.
Do hold the tension: cinematic atmosphere in the backdrop, instrument-grade precision in the foreground.
Do keep the accent rare enough to still signal — mark the single most important state or action per surface.
Do use the fixed 28px nav icon slot so Material (18px) and EVE-neocom (28px) glyphs share a baseline.
donts: Don't hardcode one of the eight data hues, or inline-style any color in JS markup — always class + token.
Don't hardcode the accent color — it is roles.accent over the active palette, expressed only through --accent*. A literal crimson hex breaks every user palette.
Don't type a fresh accent tint or hue variant by hand — derive it from a swatch via theme-vars.js (hexToRgba / lighten / darken). Only the 16 swatches are hand-set.
Don't leave two planes competing at the same clarity — an open overlay must take focus while the layer behind it blurs and dims.
Don't let the ambient nebula glows become interactive, tint data, or leave pointer-events:none / z-index:0.
Don't set numbers in the sans font or spread the accent across a field of equally-weighted buttons.
Don't add manual Sync/Refresh buttons — data auto-refreshes on ESI's own cache cadence.
Don't use emoji in the app chrome; use the Material or EVE-neocom icon families.
Don't re-introduce a YAML/JS theme engine or add a second named preset — there is one built-in theme (theme-default.css); user palettes are generated plain-CSS files, one custom property per token.
